mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_instance i WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.status = 'approving' AND (i.initiator_org_path LIKE CONCAT(#{orgPathPrefix}, '%') OR i.current_dept_id IN (SELECT so.id FROM sys_org so WHERE so.path LIKE CONCAT(#{orgPathPrefix}, '%')))

SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.biz_no, i.form_type, NULL AS node_name, u.name AS initiator_name, (SELECT ni.node_name FROM flow_node_instance ni WHERE ni.instance_id = i.id AND ni.node_seq = i.current_node_seq LIMIT 1) AS current_node_name, i.status FROM flow_instance i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.initiator_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.status = 'approving' AND (i.initiator_org_path LIKE CONCAT(#{orgPathPrefix}, '%') OR i.current_dept_id IN (SELECT so.id FROM sys_org so WHERE so.path LIKE CONCAT(#{orgPathPrefix}, '%'))) ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.biz_no FROM flow_instance i WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.status = 'approving' AND (i.initiator_org_path LIKE CONCAT(#{orgPathPrefix}, '%') OR i.current_dept_id IN (SELECT so.id FROM sys_org so WHERE so.path LIKE CONCAT(#{orgPathPrefix}, '%'))) ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'pending'

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.assignee_id, t.instance_id, i.biz_no, ni.node_name AS node_name, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id LEFT JOIN flow_node_instance ni ON ni.id = t.node_instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'pending' ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT i.biz_no FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'pending' ORDER BY i.biz_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.biz_no, i.form_type, ni.node_name AS node_name, u.name AS initiator_name, (SELECT n2.node_name FROM flow_node_instance n2 WHERE n2.instance_id = i.id AND n2.node_seq = i.current_node_seq LIMIT 1) AS current_node_name, t.status FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id LEFT JOIN flow_node_instance ni ON ni.id = t.node_instance_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.initiator_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'pending' AND i.status = 'approving' ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
